name: Research
description: Reports a company's public GitHub footprint: its top public repositories, the languages they use, and which repositories moved in the last month, each with a github.com link. It reads GitHub only through the GitHub tools granted on the Nasiko MCP gateway. A private or missing organization is reported as private or missing, and when GitHub is not connected it says so instead of answering from memory. It does not report headlines or news.

skills.name: GitHub footprint
skills.description: Repositories and languages of a company's public GitHub org: top repositories, languages, and recent activity, with key takeaways first. Not headlines, not news.
examples: Look up the GitHub organization for Northwind. Top public repositories, languages, and which repos moved in the last month. Key takeaways first. If the org is private or missing, say so.
Which languages does the Vercel GitHub org use most?
